problem: Five XLSB package/theme/raw-codec/property rows had no indexed native operation assertions. The feature matrix also incorrectly said XLSB lacked a typed property facade, although eager and source-backed metadata transactions already exist.
changes: Add seven native integration tests over the values, metadata and recorded-macro XLSB specimens, without changing library code or fixture bytes.
Index bounded assertions for xlsb-274, xlsb-275, xlsb-276, xlsb-294 and xlsb-330; correct the stale Core/package properties matrix description and document qualification limits.

verification_scope.theme_reads: All three native themes expose Office Theme/Office, twelve exact system/RGB colors, Aptos Display/Aptos Narrow, 47 supplemental scripts per font group, and native family/variant GUIDs. The source-backed view performs one cold load of the 8721-byte theme; repeated reads add none. No-op theme publication retains the original ZIP bytes.
verification_scope.theme_edits: Name, Accent1 and family-name changes survive file reopen, forward replay and inverse; only the theme payload changes. Font/effect/object-default/custom-scheme fragments stay exact. Invalid names retain staged work. Native font schemes contain panose attributes outside the Face writer model, so changing their font scheme is precisely refused with DrawingML Invalid("theme scheme contains an unsupported attribute"). Family and whole-theme removal, recreation and inverse check bounded values and graph ownership.
verification_scope.properties: Native Ryker Zhu author/modifier, three exact timestamp pairs, empty company, Macintosh Excel 16.0300 application metadata and flags agree between eager and source-backed owners. Equal metadata/app sets produce equal no-op patches and exact ZIP bytes. Title/company/custom Boolean/integer changes produce equal patches, exact equal payloads and equivalent graph output. HeadingPairs/TitlesOfParts survive unchanged; application/custom-part removal, file reopen, stale-patch refusal and inverses pass.
verification_scope.raw_codec: The values/metadata/macro packages contain 25/30/13 members. Workbook/styles/SST/first-worksheet streams have exact byte lengths, record counts and boundary kinds; Records plus Encoder reproduce each stream exactly. BrtBundleSh tab IDs, names, physical order and relationship IDs match the package targets. The values catalog starts with Sales chart before Sheet1/Sheet2. Truncating the final workbook length header yields Truncated at Stage::Length and a fused iterator.
verification_scope.generic_package_edit: Create/update/remove an inert sidecar and internal root relationship on the native macro source. Failed update closures retain previous staged work and undo only the failing call. A successful low-level update containing a truncated workbook fails validation at publication. Save/reopen and inverses preserve all unrelated payloads, including VBA.
verification_scope.graph_comparison: Unchanged payloads are byte-exact. Graph mutation comparisons require identical member sets, complete relationship element/attribute sets and effective content type for every member. Initial overly lexical comparison exposed whitespace and equivalent VML Default-versus-Override representations, not a content or ownership loss; no production change was needed.
verification_scope.limits: Recreated theme XML is Litchi-authored from a bounded native model, not exact reproduction of native unmodeled effects. No font shaping, rendering, formula calculation, refresh, macro execution or fresh Excel reopen was performed. Historical native authoring classifications remain unchanged.
